_: SCENE CONDITIONS: gate a whole scene and/or individual scene phases on CTDA conditions. Same two-NPC tavern argument as scene_spec.json, but: (1) a SCENE-LEVEL condition — the whole conversation only STARTS while the player has NO follower (GetGlobalValue PlayerFollowerCount == 0, vanilla GLOB Skyrim.esm:0x0BCC98); and (2) a PER-PHASE startCondition on phase 2 — Borin's threat line ('Watch your tongue...') only plays while PlayerFollowerCount == 0 too (if you've recruited a follower, the engine skips that phase and goes straight to Hilda's closer). IN-GAME TEST: coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn after a save+reload with NO active follower — the two converse and Borin's threat plays. Then recruit any follower (so PlayerFollowerCount becomes 1), leave + return: the scene should no longer auto-start (scene-level gate). To prove the per-phase gate alone, raise the scene-level gate's comparison if you want the scene to still start while a follower is out and watch phase 2 get skipped. Verify offline: `validate` clean; `build` to a temp esp; `scenediag` shows the scene's conditions count > 0 and phase 2 startConds=1.

quests._: Host quest for the scene. startGameEnabled (default) so the scene loads/plays.
quests.name: ModForge Scene Conditions

scenes._: conditions[] = the whole scene only STARTS if ALL pass (here: player has no follower).

lines: You still owe me for the ale, Hilda.
Owe you? That swill wasn't worth a clipped septim.

phases._: startConditions[] = this phase only PLAYS while PlayerFollowerCount == 0 (else the engine skips it).
lines: Watch your tongue, woman, or there'll be trouble.
Trouble? From you? Ha! Buy me a drink and we're even.
